Ali Asghar Ka Janaza Hai Shabbir Ko Pursa Do

Khawhish Hai Sakina Ki  Sughra Ko He Bulwa Do.

Pooch Hai Sakina Ne Baba Sai Ye Hasrat Hai

Mayyat Pe Mein Jhirkoungi

Ek Jaam Mujhe Laado.

Asghar Ka Galla Zakhmi Aur Ma Ka Jigger Chalni

Kitnay Hi Jainazay Hain

Hurmal Ko Yeh Samjha Do.

Thanha Hai Khara Run Main Koee Bhi Nahi Sathi

Shabbir Bulla Thay Hain

Roo-thay Howay Shehzadon

/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('src/data/lyrics/ali-asghar-ka-janaza-hai-nw-9711ba85533c.md')
_, meta, body = p.read_text().split('---')
roman = '\\n'.join(line.strip() for line in meta.split('romanLyrics: |-\\n')[1].splitlines())
for lyrics, numbers in [(roman, '123'), (body, '۱۲۳')]:
    opening, *stanzas = lyrics.strip().split('\\n\\n')
    assert len(opening.splitlines()) == 2
    assert len(stanzas) == len(numbers)
    for stanza, number in zip(stanzas, numbers):
        label, *verses = stanza.splitlines()
        assert label == number and len(verses) == 3
assert '\\u200c' not in body
print('Verified both editions: two opening verses and three three-verse stanzas.')
PY"
